metadata.question: Were active fire counts in Punjab and Haryana lower in November 2024 than any other November from 2012 to 2023, as observed with the VIIRS sensor?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use VIIRS daily fire product VNP14A1 (ee.ImageCollection 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1'). Filter for India’s Punjab and Haryana combined geometry using FAO GAUL Level1. Select all November images for each year 2012–2024 via calendar filters. If a November returns zero images when filterBounds is applied, retry without filterBounds as a fallback.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking; use FireMask classes. Count active fire detections by summing FireMask classes 6, 7, 8 (low/nominal/high confidence fire) across November days. Also compute valid pixel-days (sum of masks) to ensure data coverage.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: If a month has images but valid pixel-days == 0, output C2. If any month’s collection is empty after fallback, output C1. If any computed totals are null/NaN, output C3. Otherwise compare 2024 total to min(2012–2023) using strict inequality; if strictly lower, A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const gaul1 = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1');
    const states = gaul1
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'India'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.inList('ADM1_NAME', ['Punjab', 'Haryana']));
    const region = states.geometry();

    const years = ee.List.sequence(2012, 2024);

    // Helper to build Nov collection with/without bounds
    function buildNovCollection(year, useBounds) {
      let col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1')
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year'))
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 11, 'month'));
      if (useBounds) col = col.filterBounds(region);
      return col;
    }

    // Compute stats for a given year with fallback if filterBounds yields empty
    function getNovStatsWithFallback(year) {
      year = ee.Number(year).toInt();
      const colB = buildNovCollection(year, true);
      const nB = colB.size();

      const colNoB = buildNovCollection(year, false);
      const nNoB = colNoB.size();

      // Choose preferred collection
      const useB = nB.gt(0);
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(ee.Algorithms.If(useB, colB, colNoB));
      const n = ee.Number(ee.Algorithms.If(useB, nB, nNoB));

      // If still empty, mark empty and return minimal info
      const empty = n.eq(0);

      // Build fire detections (classes 6,7,8) and valid pixel-days
      const fireCol = col.map(function(img) {
        const fm = img.select('FireMask');
        const fire = fm.gte(7).or(fm.eq(6)).rename('fire').toUint8();
        return fire;
      });
      const fireSum = ee.ImageCollection(fireCol).sum();

      const validCol = col.map(function(img) {
        const v = ee.Image(1).updateMask(img.select('FireMask').mask()).rename('valid').toUint8();
        return v;
      });
      const validSum = ee.ImageCollection(validCol).sum();

      const fireCount = ee.Number(
        fireSum.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e12
        }).get('fire')
      );

      const validCount = ee.Number(
        validSum.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e12
        }).get('valid')
      );

      return ee.Dictionary({
        year: year,
        images: n,
        empty: empty,
        fire: fireCount,
        valid: validCount
      });
    }

    const statsList = years.map(function(y) { return getNovStatsWithFallback(y); });

    // Evaluate server-side results
    const stats = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      ee.List(statsList).getInfo((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res);
      });
    });

    // Basic region info
    const areaKm2 = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      region.area(1).divide(1e6).getInfo((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res);
      });
    });

    console.log(`Region: Punjab+Haryana, Area_km2: ${areaKm2.toFixed(0)}`);

    // Check for empty collections (C1) and no valid pixels (C2), and null/NaN (C3)
    let anyEmpty = false;
    let anyNoValid = false;
    let anyInvalid = false;

    // Print concise per-year stats
    stats.forEach(s => {
      const y = s.year;
      const imgs = s.images || 0;
      const empty = !!s.empty;
      const valid = s.valid;
      const fire = s.fire;

      // Identify invalids
      if (empty) anyEmpty = true;
      if (!empty) {
        if (valid === null || typeof valid !== 'number' || isNaN(valid)) anyInvalid = true;
        if (fire === null || typeof fire !== 'number' || isNaN(fire)) anyInvalid = true;
        if (!anyInvalid && valid === 0) anyNoValid = true;
      }
      const validStr = (valid === null || isNaN(valid)) ? 'null' : (Math.round(valid));
      const fireStr = (fire === null || isNaN(fire)) ? 'null' : (Math.round(fire));
      console.log(`${y} Nov: Imgs ${imgs}, ValidPixDays ${validStr}, FireDet ${fireStr}${empty ? ' (Empty)' : ''}`);
    });

    if (anyEmpty) {
      console.log('Collection empty for at least one November -> cannot compare.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (anyNoValid) {
      console.log('Images exist but zero valid pixel-days in at least one November.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (anyInvalid) {
      console.log('Computation returned null/NaN for at least one value.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Compute comparison: is 2024 strictly less than every Nov 2012-2023?
    const byYear = {};
    stats.forEach(s => { byYear[s.year] = s; });

    const fire2024 = Math.round(byYear[2024].fire);
    const prevYears = [];
    for (let y = 2012; y <= 2023; y++) prevYears.push(Math.round(byYear[y].fire));
    const prevMin = Math.min.apply(null, prevYears);

    const strictlyLower = fire2024 < prevMin;

    console.log(`Prev(2012-2023) Min FireDet: ${prevMin}, 2024: ${fire2024}, StrictLower: ${strictlyLower}`);

    // Final Answer
    if (strictlyLower) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
